desc:
[NEW!🛏️] Bedwars gamemode added to Minerscave + new bows, signs, ladders, customizable fences + more! ⚔️

🌳 Small Trees fall like real life when you chop them.
💎 Explore deep caves with cool monuments and XP crystals.
🦁 Savanna: lion prides, hyena packs, zebras and crocodiles at the waterholes.
🐪 Desert: camels, scorpions and ostriches.
🐒 Jungle: snakes, monkeys, parrots and a jungle Tradesman.
🐻‍❄️ Arctic: mammoths, polar bears, wolf packs, moose and reindeer.
🦬 Grasslands: bison, wild boar, foxes and prairie dogs.
🧟 13 infected types: screaming sirens, dynamite bombers, a night boss and more.

🎒 Your inventory always saves!
🌍 My World map/chests saves always!

🪙 Coins: earn them by mining, playing and unlocking badges – earn 4,200 per hour just by existing

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for updates!
🎁 Join our community (link below) for codes!
